identity.operation: Route XInclude and included XML parser errors to a per-context structured error handler.
identity.condition: A handler is registered with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler and a qualifying error occurs while processing the context.
identity.capability: The XInclude context stores the handler and forwards errors to it.
identity.consequence: The registered handler does not receive the error.

requirement: For a processed XInclude context with a registered structured handler, route XInclude errors and included XML parser errors to that handler.

assessment.necessity_reason: The after source supports registering a per-context structured error handler, and the old harness never registers one. A qualifying error must also be reachable through this entry to establish the coverage obligation; the supplied processing path stops before that can be determined.

before.requirement: Route a qualifying processing error to a handler registered on the XInclude context.
before.reason: The before context has no handler fields, its XInclude error helper passes no per-context handler, and the verified preimage has no setter definition in xinclude.c.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before context has no per-context error handler or handler data.
The verified preimage records no setter definition in xinclude.c.

after.requirement: When a structured handler is registered on an XInclude context and a qualifying processing error occurs, route XInclude and included XML parser errors to that handler.
after.reason: The setter stores the handler, and the error and included-file helpers forward it. The old harness does not register one. The omitted processing path prevents a supported, reachable qualifying error from being established for this entry.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: XInclude errors pass the handler and its data to the error-raising helper.
Included XML parsing forwards a registered handler to its parser context.
The after context stores the handler and its data.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Initialization sets a global generic error function but does not register a per-context structured handler.

assessment.comparison_reason: The frozen per-context routing capability is absent before and supported after. The same old harness omits registration, but the supplied source does not complete the path from its processing call to a qualifying error.
missing_information: Complete before and after xinclude.c::xmlXIncludeDoProcess, with the relevant calls through xinclude.c::xmlXIncludeLoadNode and xinclude.c::xmlXIncludeLoadDoc, to establish whether a finite harness input reaches a qualifying error.

necessity_evidence.reason: The after source supports per-context structured error routing, and the complete old entry never registers a handler. The supplied code does not show whether a finite input reaches a qualifying error through that entry’s processing call.

scope_contract.reason: XInclude context processing is a primary entry operation, and the after source adds a handler to that context.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the entry’s XInclude processing operation.

feasible_trigger.reason: The entry accepts fuzz-supplied XML and calls XInclude processing, but the supplied path stops at xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot. It does not establish a finite input that reaches a qualifying XInclude or included-parser error.

evidence.dependency_reason: Processing delegates to xmlXIncludeDoProcess, whose body was not supplied.
Included-file parsing can receive a registered handler, but its reachability from the entry is unproved.

observable_consequence.reason: If a qualifying error occurs, the after source forwards the context’s handler; this entry leaves that handler unset, so it cannot receive the error through this route. Whether the error condition is reachable remains unknown.

evidence.dependency_reason: The setter stores the structured handler and its data.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry has no per-context registration call. Its global generic error hook is a different route and supplies no registered context handler or handler data.

evidence.dependency_reason: Included parsing forwards the handler only when the context has one.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple is per-context handler routing during XInclude processing. The before context and XInclude error path lack that capability; the after context and error path add it. This does not establish trigger reachability.

evidence.dependency_reason: The same fixed entry creates and processes the context without registration.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The included XML parser receives the registered handler.
The before XInclude error path has no per-context handler argument.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzz input supplies the main XML entity and optional named entities.

missing_information: The complete after processing path from xmlXIncludeProcessNode through xmlXIncludeDoProcess to a qualifying error, sufficient to construct a finite input under the supplied entry’s input format.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Deliver a qualifying XInclude or included XML parser error to a structured handler registered on the XInclude context.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Create an XInclude context, register a structured handler with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler, then process input that causes a qualifying error.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old entry creates a context, sets flags, processes the document, and frees the context without registering a structured handler.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: A registered per-context handler receiving the processing error; a finite qualifying error input is not yet established.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The entry’s global generic error hook does not register a structured handler on the XInclude context; no equivalent route appears in the complete entry.
